summary: Copy SharedArrayBuffer bytes into a distinct shared buffer while preserving shared-memory semantics.

tests.name: copy range
tests.input: const b=new SharedArrayBuffer(3); new Uint8Array(b).set([1,2,3]); const c=b.slice(1); console.log([...new Uint8Array(c)]);

tests.name: distinct storage
tests.input: const b=new SharedArrayBuffer(2); new Uint8Array(b)[0]=1; const c=b.slice(0); new Uint8Array(b)[0]=9; console.log(new Uint8Array(c)[0]);
